Pure Hydration, Nothing Hidden, The Bare Vegan Lip Balm

This is our best-selling lip balm!

The ultimate no-makeup makeup essential, invisible hydration that lets your natural lips shine through. Packed with the power of not one, but two skin-loving certified organic plant butters, Cocoa and Mango, the Bare Lip Balm is the minimalist's lip essential. One product, all-day hydration that helps prevent dryness and keeps lips looking soft, shiny and naturally healthy. A five-minute beauty routine starts here.

Key Features:

A skin-first lip balm that nourishes as it protects, gentle enough for sensitive skin and sensitive lips.

description.plain:
Ingredients

BEESWAX, COCONUT OIL, SUNFLOWER SEED OIL, MANGO BUTTER

Embrace the essence of pure, uncomplicated care with the Kobeesco Original Beeswax Lip Balm. This meticulously formulated lip balm, made with just four simple yet powerful ingredients, offers a natural and effective solution for keeping your lips hydrated and healthy. It's an ideal choice for those who love minimalism and are conscious about the environment.

Key Ingredients:

  1. Beeswax: Forms the foundation of our lip balm, providing a natural protective barrier that helps retain moisture, while still allowing your lips to breathe comfortably.
  2. Coconut Oil: Known for its moisturizing properties, coconut oil deeply nourishes the lips, keeping them soft and supple.
  3. Sunflower Oil: Rich in vitamins and antioxidants, sunflower oil helps in soothing chapped lips and offers an additional layer of hydration.
  4. Mango Butter: A natural emollient, mango butter is excellent for smoothing and moisturizing, adding a luxurious feel to the balm.

Packaging:

  • Eco-Friendly Approach: True to our commitment to sustainability, the Kobeesco Original Beeswax Lip Balm is housed in cardboard compostable packaging. This eco-conscious choice ensures that you can take care of your lips and the planet simultaneously.

Benefits:

  • Simplicity at Its Best: With only four natural ingredients, this lip balm is free from any additives, fragrances, or synthetic chemicals, making it perfect for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
  • Deep Hydration: The combination of beeswax, coconut oil, sunflower oil, and mango butter ensures that your lips are deeply moisturized and protected from external elements.
  • Environmentally Responsible: The compostable packaging aligns with a zero-waste lifestyle and reflects our dedication to environmental stewardship.

How to Use:

  • Apply generously on your lips as often as needed.
  • Enjoy the natural, hydrating experience and peace of mind from using a product that's good for you and the environment.

The Kobeesco Original Beeswax Lip Balm is not just a lip care product; it's a statement of purity, simplicity, and environmental responsibility. Indulge in the natural goodness and join us in our journey towards a more sustainable future! 

Other ways to enjoy: These balms work wonders for softening and soothing dry lips, but what can moisturize one thing, can also help moisturize other parts of your body too! Try our chubby little balm on nails & cuticles, under eyes at night, scars, tattoos, to tame flyaway hairs, to soothe other dry, chapped spots that could use a little love and more!
 *External use only. 

Please Note: The packaging for this product is made from 100% biodegradable paper, so naturally some wear and tear are to be expected. To best preserve your lip + body balm, please store at room temperature and avoid direct sunlight and moisture. Careful not to leave it in a hot car! If you need anything at all we are here to help!

 

ABOUT THE LIP BALM!!!!!

Don't let the size fool you! Kobeesco's lip balms may appear shorter and a bit wider than your traditional plastic lip balm tubes, but they're designed this way for a good reason. Each of our balms holds the same amount of nourishing product as a standard tube. The unique, shorter shape isn't just about standing out – it's carefully crafted to enhance functionality. This design allows for an efficient push-up feature, making it easy to use every last bit of our natural, hydrating formula. With Kobeesco, you're getting the full value in a compact, eco-friendly, and user-friendly package. Experience the same amount of product, with a touch of innovation and sustainability! 

A single lip balm is 0.2OZ - 0.4OZ total.

description.plain:
A little color. A lot of nourishment.

Meet your everyday lip ritual: three naturally tinted balms handcrafted with nourishing plant oils, butters, and a touch of color to enhance your natural glow.

Our Tinted Balm Trio combines the comfort of a moisturizing lip balm with the beauty of a sheer, buildable tint. Each shade melts into your lips, leaving them soft, hydrated, and naturally radiant.

Inspired by Mediterranean beauty traditions, these effortless shades are made for everyday moments like morning coffee, beach days, dinner with friends, and everywhere in between.

Because the best beauty routines are the ones that feel like you.

Includes:

Terra
Meaning “earth” in Italian, Terra brings a warm, natural nude hue inspired by the grounding beauty of nature. Its earthy color comes from Indian Madder, a botanical from the coffee family.

Rosa
Meaning “rose” in Italian, Rosa brings a soft pink-purple hue inspired by the delicate beauty of rose petals. Its natural coloring comes from the petals of this timeless flower, creating a subtle flush of color for your lips.

Vino
Meaning “wine” in Italian, Vino brings a rich red hue inspired by the deep, vibrant tones of Italian wine. Its natural coloring comes from beet root powder, transforming a simple plant into a beautiful, wearable shade.

description.plain:
Made with coconut milk, white kaolin clay, and Brazilian rose clay, this Terra Beauty Bars Rose Coconut Dry Facial Clay Mask was developed for dry to normal skin. Each 2-ounce jar of this dry clay mask powder is finely crafted with 100% natural, vegan botanicals. Just 1–2 teaspoons mixed with a few drops of liquid provide an ultra-nourishing and hydrating facial experience.

Prefer something for more oily skin types? Check out Terra Beauty Bars other facial clay masks like the Matcha Sea Dry Clay Mask for normal to oily skin, or the Volcanic Ash Dry Clay Mask for oily to combo skin.

Why is this rose clay dry mask waterless?

Unlike a sheet mask or clay mask squeezed from a tube, this dry powder is a concentrated blend of loose clay. Combined with your choice of purified water or coconut milk, the paste effectively draws out impurities and leaves your skin baby-soft. Try aloe vera or rose water, or add a few drops of argan oil to this Terra Beauty Bars Rose Coconut Dry Facial Clay Mask for extra moisturizing power. We consider it a DIY facial mask experience!

Women-owned and operated, made in the USA

Terra Beauty Bars was established by three first-generation Brazilian-American sisters with farming roots in Brazil and Italy. With each sale of this Terra Beauty Bars Rose Coconut Dry Facial Clay Mask (and other Terra Beauty Bars products), a charitable contribution is made to empower women and children.

description.plain:
Description

  • Mild by Nature, Sierra Bees Organic Lip Balms
  • Featuring Sustainably Sourced Beeswax, Olive Oil, Sunflower Oil & Vitamin E
  • Formulated to be: USDA Organic, Non-GMO, Cruelty-Free
  • Made with Eco-Friendly & Biodegradable Ingredients
  • No Sulfates, No Preservatives, No Artificial Fragrances & No Animal Testing
  • Certified Organic by Oregon Tilth
  • Bee good to your Lips!


We’re excited to share that Sierra Bees is now a part of the Mild By Nature family of products. You can still expect the same eco-conscious and nature-inspired formulas, just with a new brand and a new family of effective personal care products.

Variety Pack - Cocoa Butter - Honey - Mint Burst- Pomegranate - Crème Brûlée

Our Sustainable, USDA-Certified Organic Beeswax is sourced from established Bee Farmers who meet our stringent social, environmental and economic requirements.

We purchase our USDA Organic Beeswax from well-established bee farmers, who are often the third or fourth generation in the trade and have learned from decades of hands-on experience. Their livelihood is dependent on the ethical and humane collection of crude wax and honey. These farmers take pride in providing a high quality, consistent products year after year, without endangering bees or other wildlife.

The collection of our Organic Beeswax takes place in organized apiaries, or out in the wild — where collectors do their best to ensure the bees are well cared for. By constantly monitoring the hives, farmers can make certain the bees are healthy and well fed throughout the year, especially during times of drought or frost. Many of our bee farmers use wooden hives, which are hung from trees, so wild animals cannot disturb them

In addition, the majority of our bee farmers contribute to ongoing government and university-funded research. This crucial research is intended to develop better ways to handle bees, and keep them safe in their natural habitat.

Organic Beeswax is a naturally sustainable product from Mother Nature. It is up to us to protect bees, so that they will continue to pollinate and produce high-quality Organic Beeswax for generations to come.

description.plain:
You'll love how soft and moisturized your lips will feel with our botanical lip balm! The sweet, exotic scent of Vanilla lifts the spirits and comforts the mind as well as the lips. Our Organic Vanilla is extracted with CO2. Of all the extraction methods, this creates the purest aroma and most powerful plant-essence direct from the Vanilla Bean.

Organic Oils of Jojoba Seed and Extra Virgin Olive, Wheat Germ, and Fair Trade Unrefined Shea Butter soothe, balance and protect your skin while helping prevent chapped lips.

Organic Herbal Infusions of Comfrey Leaf and Root, Marshmallow Root, Slippery Elm and Chickweed calm, replenish and hydrate the skin while helping it regenerate. Herbal Infusions release these deeply nourishing plant's vitamins, minerals, and other beneficial components through a long steeping process.

These plant-based ingredients work together to create a hydrating herbal protective barrier for your lips that is smooth and long-lasting.

This lip balm is a sweet send-off for your day! Wear by itself or under lipstick.

Reapply as often as needed.

Can also be used on cuticles.

 

General Precautions: We recommend that you consult with a qualified healthcare practitioner before using herbal products, particularly if you are pregnant, nursing, or on any medications. Persons with allergies should exercise caution.

Common Name:

*High Oleic Safflower, +Pure Honey Beeswax, *Golden Jojoba Seed Oil, +Wheat Germ Oil, +Fair Trade Unrefined Shea Butter, Herbal Oil Infusions of *Comfrey Leaf & Root, *Marshmallow Root, *Slippery Elm & *Chickweed, *Seabuckthorn CO2, Essential Oils of *Red Mandarin & *Vanilla, Antioxidants of +Sage & *Rosemary

*Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, +Beeswax, *Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, +Triticum Vulgare (Wheat) Germ Oil, +Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, *Symphytum Officinale (Comfrey) Leaf/Root Extract, *Althaea Officinalis (Marshmallow) Root Extract, *Ulmus Fulva (Slippery Elm) Bark Extract, *Stellaria Media (Chickweed) Extract, *Hippophae Rhamnoides (Seabuckthorn) Fruit Extract, *Citrus Reticulata (Red Mandarin) Peel Oil, *Vanilla Planifolia Oil, +Salvia Triloba (Sage) Leaf Extract, *Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract

No GMOs, sodium lauryl or laureth sulfates, petroleum-based products, parabens, phthalates, artificial dyes or synthetic ingredients or fragrances.

description.plain:
A little color. A lot of nourishment.

Meet your everyday lip ritual: three naturally tinted balms handcrafted with nourishing plant oils, butters, and a touch of color to enhance your natural glow.

Our Tinted Balm Trio combines the comfort of a moisturizing lip balm with the beauty of a sheer, buildable tint. Each shade melts into your lips, leaving them soft, hydrated, and naturally radiant.

Inspired by Mediterranean beauty traditions, these effortless shades are made for everyday moments like morning coffee, beach days, dinner with friends, and everywhere in between.

Because the best beauty routines are the ones that feel like you.

Includes:

Terra
Meaning “earth” in Italian, Terra brings a warm, natural nude hue inspired by the grounding beauty of nature. Its earthy color comes from Indian Madder, a botanical from the coffee family.

Rosa
Meaning “rose” in Italian, Rosa brings a soft pink-purple hue inspired by the delicate beauty of rose petals. Its natural coloring comes from the petals of this timeless flower, creating a subtle flush of color for your lips.

Vino
Meaning “wine” in Italian, Vino brings a rich red hue inspired by the deep, vibrant tones of Italian wine. Its natural coloring comes from beet root powder, transforming a simple plant into a beautiful, wearable shade.

description.plain:
Made with coconut milk, white kaolin clay, and Brazilian rose clay, this Terra Beauty Bars Rose Coconut Dry Facial Clay Mask was developed for dry to normal skin. Each 2-ounce jar of this dry clay mask powder is finely crafted with 100% natural, vegan botanicals. Just 1–2 teaspoons mixed with a few drops of liquid provide an ultra-nourishing and hydrating facial experience.

Prefer something for more oily skin types? Check out Terra Beauty Bars other facial clay masks like the Matcha Sea Dry Clay Mask for normal to oily skin, or the Volcanic Ash Dry Clay Mask for oily to combo skin.

Why is this rose clay dry mask waterless?

Unlike a sheet mask or clay mask squeezed from a tube, this dry powder is a concentrated blend of loose clay. Combined with your choice of purified water or coconut milk, the paste effectively draws out impurities and leaves your skin baby-soft. Try aloe vera or rose water, or add a few drops of argan oil to this Terra Beauty Bars Rose Coconut Dry Facial Clay Mask for extra moisturizing power. We consider it a DIY facial mask experience!

Women-owned and operated, made in the USA

Terra Beauty Bars was established by three first-generation Brazilian-American sisters with farming roots in Brazil and Italy. With each sale of this Terra Beauty Bars Rose Coconut Dry Facial Clay Mask (and other Terra Beauty Bars products), a charitable contribution is made to empower women and children.

Crafted with a blend of nature’s most nourishing ingredients, this balm locks in moisture, soothes irritation, and promotes skin elasticity without any synthetic fillers or harsh chemicals.

✅ Deeply Hydrating – Beef tallow mimics your skin’s natural oils, providing intense moisture and essential nutrients.
✅ Protective Barrier – Beeswax seals in hydration and shields lips from harsh elements.

✅ Customizable – Infused with your favorite essential oils for a refreshing, personalized touch.

🧈 Beef Tallow – Rich in vitamins A, D, E & K, it deeply nourishes and restores skin elasticity.

💧 Vitamin E Oil – A powerful antioxidant that promotes healing and keeps lips looking youthful.
🌿 Essential Oils (Optional) – Customize with your favorite scent while reaping aromatherapy benefits.

description.plain:
Vegan Highlighter – Body and Face Shimmer for Buildable Glow

NARA BEAUTY Vegan Highlighter delivers silky, buildable radiance for a luminous, polished finish. Sweep it across cheekbones, brow bones, cupid’s bow, or collarbones for a soft sheen or bold, light-catching glow. Available in versatile shades to complement every complexion.

Texture, Finish & Application FAQ

Will it emphasize pores or texture?

Shimmer reflects light and can make pores and uneven texture more noticeable. Vegan Highlighter is buildable, so start with a light layer and keep the strongest glow on areas you want to highlight rather than across visible texture.

Who is it best suited to?

Anyone looking for a vegan, buildable face-and-body glow, from a soft sheen to a bolder highlight. Dry skin benefits from moisturized prep, while oily or combination skin may prefer targeted placement away from shiny areas. Skin-type suitability and results can vary.

Before or after foundation?

For a targeted highlight, start with a small amount over foundation once your base has settled. Gently tap or sweep without rubbing, and build gradually. If you're not wearing foundation, apply Vegan Highlighter to prepped bare skin.

What finish works best when texture is a concern?

A sheer, softly blended sheen is a good starting point. Use less product, blend the edges, and avoid building an intense reflective layer over pores, bumps, or fine lines.

Enjoy customizable radiance with our Vegan Highlighter, designed for versatile face-and-body highlighting.

Protect your skin with double the defense. The PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen is a high-protection, lightweight sun solution with a silky, fast-absorbing texture. With SPF 50+ and PA++++, this sunscreen is formulated with dependable,
broad-spectrum UVA and UVB protection. Its complementary infusion of five different Ceramides also helps defend the skin barrier against external

matte finish that leaves zero white cast

Designed for double defense, the PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen joins the PURITO Daily Go-To Sunscreen in the Daily line. Created in collaboration with our community, the PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen was developed as a part of our Create Me program. Hundreds of community members participated in selecting the sun solution’s ingredients, design, and name. The formula underwent several rounds of thorough quality checks and rigorous testing throughout the development process to ensure reliable protection and performance.

This fast-absorbing, lightweight sunscreen best suits oily and combination skin types and delivers two-fold protection. In addition to broad spectrum SPF 50+ and PA++++ UV filters, the soft and silky formula is infused with a suite of five Ceramides that help strengthen the skin barrier. Ceramides NS, NP, AS, AP, and EOP work together to help shield the skin from environmental stressors and support the skin barrier with deep moisturization. The white-cast-free, non-irritating formula is also non-sticky and non-greasy.

 An additional four skin-loving ingredients create the ultimate curated complement. Centella Asiatica Extract, also known as Cica, helps to soothe any sensitive or irritated skin. Panthenol and Tocopherol assist with locking in moisture and protecting the skin from external stressors. Finally, Alpha-Bisabolol supports a more even complexion.

Key Ingredients
5 Ceramides
The five ceramides (NS, NP, AS, AP, and EOP) provide deep moisture, strengthen the skin barrier, and protect you against external stress. Simultaneously, they retain moisture, preventing water loss and leaving your skin feeling hydrated.

Centella
Centella effectively soothes sensitive and irritated skin, providing comforting relief.

Panthenol
Soothing Panthenol strengthens the skin barrier and leaves the skin moisturized.

How to Use
Use daily as the last step of your skincare routine.
Apply evenly on the face 15 minutes before sun exposure.
Reapply every two to three hours during the day and immediately after towel drying, swimming, or perspiring.

5 Ceramides

Glow-boosting serum with an advanced form of vitamin C, clinically proven to visibly brighten, smooth, and reduce discoloration — Boosted by vitamin E & ferulic acid, with chamomile and konjac root to calm and protect.

  • Vitamin C (Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate) - A highly stable, barrier-safe form of vitamin C that delivers visibly brighter skin and improved texture. It absorbs efficiently, stays active longer, and is ideal for daily use — perfect for acne-prone skin.

description.plain:
A classic of Brazilian hair therapy, reimagined for daily strength and vitality. The Grandha Tonific Shampoo is a phytotherapeutic tonic shampoo formulated to fortify hair from the root, stimulate the scalp, and restore balance to the hair system.

Developed by Grandha Professional Hair Care as part of the beloved Flores & Vegetais line, this shampoo combines concentrated extracts of aloe vera and Brazilian ginseng (Pfaffia paniculata) with the invigorating properties of rosemary essential oil — three powerhouse botanicals recognized for their stimulating, revitalizing, and strengthening effects. Ideal for those seeking daily hair fortification without stripping or irritation, it delivers a gentle yet effective cleanse that leaves hair more resistant, healthy, and full of vitality. Certified by the Brazilian Academy of Trichology (ABT) and dermatologically tested.

Key Benefits

  • Root-to-Tip Fortification: Strengthens hair fibers from the root, reducing breakage and improving overall resilience.
  • Scalp Stimulation: Ginseng and rosemary essential oil help invigorate the scalp and support local microcirculation.
  • Gentle Toning Action: Promotes a balanced, tonified scalp environment that supports healthy hair function.
  • Daily Use Formula: Mild enough for frequent use without causing dryness or buildup.
  • Phytotherapeutic Care: Natural-active formulation with concentrated botanical extracts for gentle, effective results.

Ingredients (Highlights)

  • Aloe Vera Leaf Extract (Aloe Barbadensis): Deeply hydrates and soothes the scalp while supporting hair fiber strength and elasticity.
  • Brazilian Ginseng Root Extract (Pfaffia paniculata): An adaptogenic Amazonian active known for its revitalizing and energizing properties — supports hair follicle vitality.
  • Rosemary Leaf Essential Oil (Rosmarinus Officinalis): Stimulates scalp circulation and provides a refreshing, invigorating sensation during cleansing.
  • Decyl Glucoside: A mild, plant-derived surfactant that ensures gentle cleansing without stripping natural oils.
  • Salicylic Acid: Helps gently exfoliate the scalp, supporting a healthy, balanced environment for hair growth.
  • Menthol: Delivers a cooling, refreshing sensation that invigorates the scalp.
  • Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride: A natural conditioning agent that improves hair manageability and softness without buildup.

Allergen Warnings / Cautions

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse thoroughly with water. Do not apply to injured or irritated scalp. Discontinue use if sensitivity occurs. Keep out of reach of children. This product is a phytotherapeutic cosmetic; natural precipitation of active ingredients may occur during storage — shake well before use. Certified by the Brazilian Academy of Trichology (ABT). Dermatologically tested. Not tested on animals.

Founded in 2000 in Taboão da Serra, Brazil, Grandha Professional Hair Care is a family-owned powerhouse that has redefined professional cosmetics across Latin America and beyond. Built on a legacy of biotechnology, nanotechnology, and the sustainable use of active ingredients from the Amazon biodiversity, Grandha earned its reputation as a pioneer in hair therapy — the fastest-growing segment in Brazilian professional haircare.

What is the Grandha Tonific Shampoo for?

It is a tonic strengthening shampoo formulated to fortify hair, stimulate the scalp, and promote a balanced, healthy hair system through natural botanical extracts.

Can I use it daily?

Yes. Its gentle formula is suitable for daily use as part of a continuous hair care or strengthening routine.

Does it help with hair breakage?

Yes. By strengthening hair fibers from the root and improving overall resilience, it helps reduce breakage and supports healthier, more resistant hair.

Does it contain natural ingredients?

Yes. The formula features concentrated extracts of aloe vera, Brazilian ginseng (Pfaffia paniculata), and rosemary essential oil, along with other plant-derived ingredients.

Is this product tested on animals?

No. Grandha does not test their products on animals. The Tonific Shampoo is dermatologically tested and certified by the Brazilian Academy of Trichology (ABT).

How long does a 300 ml bottle last?

With daily use, a 300 ml bottle typically lasts 4 to 6 weeks, depending on hair length and frequency of washing.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does the Kitsch Argan Milk Leave In Conditioner fit a minimalist hair care routine?

Yes. It combines detangling, moisture, frizz control, and shine in a single product, eliminating the need for separate conditioner, detangler, and styling sprays—perfect for a less-is-more routine.

Is the bottle design simple and uncluttered enough for a clean vanity?

Yes. The bottle features a clean label with neutral tones and minimal text, designed to blend seamlessly into a minimalist bathroom or vanity setup.

Will this product help me reduce the number of products on my shelf?

Absolutely. Because it functions as a leave-in conditioner, detangler, and shine spray in one, you can replace several specialty bottles with a single multi-purpose product.

Is the formula free from unnecessary additives that clutter an ingredient list?

Yes. The formula is vegan, cruelty-free, silicone-free, and sulfate-free, with a focused ingredient list centered on argan milk, murumuru seed butter, and Actimilk.

Does the scent overpower a neutral, scent-free home environment?

The toasted vanilla and macadamia milk scent is warm and softly diffused. It lingers in hair rather than filling a room, so it complements a minimalist, neutral-scented home without overwhelming it.

Can I use this one product for all my hair needs, even with different hair concerns?

Yes. It is formulated for curly, wavy, fine, dry, and damaged hair, so a single bottle covers multiple concerns without requiring a shelf of specialty products.

Is this leave-in spray a good replacement for several styling products?

For many users, yes. It handles detangling, moisture, frizz control, and light shine, reducing the need for a separate detangler, leave-in cream, and finishing spray.

How does the ingredient list compare to a typical drugstore conditioner?

The Kitsch formula is notably cleaner—free from silicones, sulfates, and animal-derived ingredients—delivering meaningful results without the long list of synthetic additives found in many conventional conditioners.

How does this compare to multi-step hair care routines?

A multi-step routine may offer more targeted results, but it requires more time, products, and shelf space. This single-step spray delivers 35% softer hair in one hour with far less complexity.

Is this better than buying a separate detangler and leave-in conditioner?

Yes. Combining both functions in one bottle saves space, money, and decision fatigue—exactly the kind of efficiency a minimalist routine prioritizes.

How does this leave-in spray compare to a cleansing conditioner or co-wash?

A co-wash cleanses the hair, while this spray is a leave-in treatment that stays in the hair. They serve different purposes, but this spray is a great minimalist complement to a co-wash for moisture and detangling between washes.

Is the price justified for a minimalist who only wants essentials?

Yes. While the upfront cost may be slightly higher than a basic conditioner, replacing multiple products with one bottle offers long-term savings and supports a minimalist philosophy of buying fewer, better items.

Will this product weigh my hair down if I prefer a barely-there feel?

No. The lightweight argan milk and murumuru seed butter blend is specifically designed to deliver moisture and shine without heaviness, leaving hair feeling airy and natural.

Can I use this product if I am trying to simplify my entire beauty routine?

Yes. It is one of the easiest swaps to make when simplifying, because it consolidates detangling, conditioning, and styling prep into a single step that fits almost any routine.

Does this product come in recyclable or sustainable packaging?

Kitsch is committed to sustainability, and the bottle is designed to be recyclable. Check your local recycling guidelines for specifics on plastic spray bottle preparation.

Will one bottle really replace everything I currently use?

It can replace most detanglers, leave-in conditioners, and lightweight shine sprays. If you use specialty products like deep treatments or heat protectants, those can be added as needed, but the daily routine becomes far simpler.

How do I use the Kitsch Argan Milk Leave In Conditioner Spray?

Shake the bottle well, then spray evenly onto clean, damp hair from mid-lengths to ends. Comb through with a wide-tooth comb or fingers to distribute. Style as usual. It can also be spritzed onto dry hair to refresh, tame frizz, or add shine between washes.

Can I use this leave-in conditioner on dry hair or only wet hair?

Both. It works on wet hair as a post-wash detangler and moisture boost, and on dry hair as a midday frizz smoother, refresher, or light styling finisher.

How often should I use this leave-in spray?

You can use it daily, whether washing daily or every few days. The gentle, silicone-free formula is designed for frequent use without buildup.

Is this product compatible with color-treated or chemically treated hair?

Yes. The silicone-free, sulfate-free, vegan formula is gentle on color-treated, highlighted, and chemically processed hair. For best results, avoid using sulfate-based shampoos that may strip color.

Will this leave-in conditioner work with my other hair styling products?

Yes. It layers well under oils, mousses, gels, and heat protectants. Apply it first to damp hair, then follow with your usual styling products.

What is included in the box when I order this product?

You will receive one 6.3oz bottle of Kitsch Argan Milk Leave In Conditioner Spray with a finger-pump sprayer. No additional accessories are required, though a wide-tooth comb is recommended for best results.

Is this product safe for sensitive skin and scalp?

Yes. The formula is silicone-free, sulfate-free, vegan, and cruelty-free, with no harsh detergents. If you have a known allergy or very sensitive skin, perform a small patch test on the inner forearm before full application.

Does this product contain any ingredients I should be cautious about?

The formula is free from silicones, sulfates, parabens, and animal-derived ingredients. It does contain fragrance, so those with fragrance sensitivities should review the full ingredient list on the product page before use.

What is the difference between a leave-in conditioner and a rinse-out conditioner?

A rinse-out conditioner is applied in the shower and washed out after a few minutes, while a leave-in conditioner stays in the hair to provide ongoing moisture, detangling, and protection throughout the day. Leave-ins are especially helpful for curly, wavy, dry, or damaged hair that needs continuous hydration.

Is this product compatible with color-treated or chemically treated hair?

Yes. The silicone-free, sulfate-free, vegan formula is gentle on color-treated, highlighted, and chemically processed hair. For best results, avoid using sulfate-based shampoos that may strip color.

Will this leave-in conditioner work with my other hair styling products?

Yes. It layers well under oils, mousses, gels, and heat protectants. Apply it first to damp hair, then follow with your usual styling products.

What is included in the box when I order this product?

You will receive one 6.3oz bottle of Kitsch Argan Milk Leave In Conditioner Spray with a finger-pump sprayer. No additional accessories are required, though a wide-tooth comb is recommended for best results.

Is this product safe for sensitive skin and scalp?

Yes. The formula is silicone-free, sulfate-free, vegan, and cruelty-free, with no harsh detergents. If you have a known allergy or very sensitive skin, perform a small patch test on the inner forearm before full application.

Does this product contain any ingredients I should be cautious about?

The formula is free from silicones, sulfates, parabens, and animal-derived ingredients. It does contain fragrance, so those with fragrance sensitivities should review the full ingredient list on the product page before use.

What is the difference between a leave-in conditioner and a rinse-out conditioner?

A rinse-out conditioner is applied in the shower and washed out after a few minutes, while a leave-in conditioner stays in the hair to provide ongoing moisture, detangling, and protection throughout the day. Leave-ins are especially helpful for curly, wavy, dry, or damaged hair that needs continuous hydration.

description.plain: Carrot is not a note most fragrance houses would risk naming outright, and Happy Heart Perfume includes it without apology. Cucumber, mandarin orange and cassia open this Eau de Parfum crisp and slightly spiced, an unusual pairing of vegetal freshness against citrus warmth. Water hyacinth and carrot fill the middle, an unconventional combination that reads more green than sweet. White woods and sandalwood settle into a soft, clean base. Clinique classifies this Happy Heart Eau de Parfum as fresh green, built for daytime wear, easy and understated in a way that matches the brand's dermatologist-friendly reputation. Carrot seed, the actual material used here rather than the vegetable itself, brings a dry, slightly woody, orris-adjacent character in perfumery quite different from what the raw vegetable might suggest, and it's precisely this unexpected register that keeps Happy Heart from smelling like a novelty note experiment. The carrot note is the main point of interest here: earthy rather than sweet, it keeps the whole composition from reading as just another interchangeable citrus-floral built for an office desk drawer, one of Clinique's more conceptually interesting fragrance releases still, despite the brand's overall reputation for straightforward simplicity, proof the house is capable of more conceptual ambition than its mainstream image suggests.

description.plain:
在塔斯马尼亚岛的热带雨林中有一种开着精致洁白的花朵的瑞香科树木，她的名字叫革木（Leatherwood）。这是一种只有在澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚岛上才能找到的特殊植物。这些盛开的花朵散发着一种淡淡的、清新的木质香味。蜜蜂们采了这种带有特殊芬芳的花粉就酿造出了我们美味的又独一无二的革木蜂蜜。

当你初次品尝塔斯马尼亚革木蜂蜜的时候，首先注意到的肯定是它不同寻常的浓度，其他任何普通液体蜂蜜完全不能与之相比.它不是一种清亮透明的液体，而是一种颜色金黄，质感粘稠，柔和细腻，是未经任何加工的天然结晶蜂蜜。塔斯马尼亚革木蜂蜜具有特别柔和、细腻和滑润的质地，涂抹起来很容易，它的外表跟黄油很相似，但香味馥郁持久，颜色金黄明亮，且含水量少，是不可多得的口感清纯的纯天然蜂蜜！

大多数品种的纯蜂蜜，如果没有在加工过程中受热，它们最终一般都会糖化或晶体化.有些蜂蜜生产商在加工蜂蜜的过程中，就会通过严格掌控温度（如我们所采用的冷萃取方式）来获取蜂蜜最终的结晶效果. Pure Origins倾向于第一种生产方式，即采用不加热的冷萃取方式来加工蜂蜜。因为我们的观点是只有最原始的蜂蜜才能在口感、香味以及健康品质方面给人以充分的纯天然健康蜂蜜的体验。

平行進口
澳洲製造

PURE ORIGINS ORGANIC LEATHERWOOD HONEY
Tasmania, Austrailia is where you can find the rare Leatherwood Tree. Leatherwood (Eucryphia Lucida) is a tree that grows in the forests of Tasmania’s wild west coast, from the northwest in such places as the Tarkine and through the South West Wilderness. It likes water a lot which is why it grows very well in climates of 1500–2500 mm annual rainfall. The Leatherwood Tree originated nearly 65 million years ago. We source this premium honey from the heart of the Tarkine, in the pristine Tasmanian wilderness.

Leatherwood is the single most important nectar plant in Tasmania, giving about 70% of all honey produced. The international Slow Food movement in its Ark of Taste has recognized that Leatherwood honey is monofloral honey.

Parallel import
Made in Australia

      A5：不論任何時間飲用皆可，但最推薦在早晨空腹，或晚上睡前一小時服用。此時身體的修復機能最活躍，吸收率最理想。我們的水解胜肽粉質結構非常穩定，完全可以用熱咖啡、熱茶或暖水沖調，高溫並不會破壞其胜肽結構，讓您隨心調配喜愛的日常特飲。

description.plain:
在塔斯马尼亚岛的热带雨林中有一种开着精致洁白的花朵的瑞香科树木，她的名字叫革木（Leatherwood）。这是一种只有在澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚岛上才能找到的特殊植物。这些盛开的花朵散发着一种淡淡的、清新的木质香味。蜜蜂们采了这种带有特殊芬芳的花粉就酿造出了我们美味的又独一无二的革木蜂蜜。

当你初次品尝塔斯马尼亚革木蜂蜜的时候，首先注意到的肯定是它不同寻常的浓度，其他任何普通液体蜂蜜完全不能与之相比.它不是一种清亮透明的液体，而是一种颜色金黄，质感粘稠，柔和细腻，是未经任何加工的天然结晶蜂蜜。塔斯马尼亚革木蜂蜜具有特别柔和、细腻和滑润的质地，涂抹起来很容易，它的外表跟黄油很相似，但香味馥郁持久，颜色金黄明亮，且含水量少，是不可多得的口感清纯的纯天然蜂蜜！

大多数品种的纯蜂蜜，如果没有在加工过程中受热，它们最终一般都会糖化或晶体化.有些蜂蜜生产商在加工蜂蜜的过程中，就会通过严格掌控温度（如我们所采用的冷萃取方式）来获取蜂蜜最终的结晶效果. Pure Origins倾向于第一种生产方式，即采用不加热的冷萃取方式来加工蜂蜜。因为我们的观点是只有最原始的蜂蜜才能在口感、香味以及健康品质方面给人以充分的纯天然健康蜂蜜的体验。

平行進口
澳洲製造

PURE ORIGINS ORGANIC LEATHERWOOD HONEY
Tasmania, Austrailia is where you can find the rare Leatherwood Tree. Leatherwood (Eucryphia Lucida) is a tree that grows in the forests of Tasmania’s wild west coast, from the northwest in such places as the Tarkine and through the South West Wilderness. It likes water a lot which is why it grows very well in climates of 1500–2500 mm annual rainfall. The Leatherwood Tree originated nearly 65 million years ago. We source this premium honey from the heart of the Tarkine, in the pristine Tasmanian wilderness.

Leatherwood is the single most important nectar plant in Tasmania, giving about 70% of all honey produced. The international Slow Food movement in its Ark of Taste has recognized that Leatherwood honey is monofloral honey.

Parallel import
Made in Australia

description.plain:
PLEASE NOTE: This is a PRE SALE item. These aren't shipping until December 15th. Just in time for Christmas on the 25th December. If you need it before hand, please don't buy as a gift. Thank you!! 

Made with high-quality stainless steel, these insulated water bottles are honestly the best we have tried before. 

Keeps water cold for 24 hours 

Keeps boiling water hot for 6-10 hours 

The chug cap lid is made of stainless steel, keeping your water colder for longer compared to other bottles. They are also lighter to carry, while still being insulated enough for long adventures. They include a carry handle, and the small lid cap magnetically attaches to the bottle while you drink away, to avoid misplacing it. Also features a wide mouth lid to easily refill or to add ice cubes. Available in 4 colours.  Dishwasher safe, BPA Free. Please note that colours may appear differently in real life than photos. 

The charity:

With every drink bottle sold, 5 meals are donated to children in need in Kenya. Along with providing clean safe drinking water to their schools. This is done through our charity partner OpBlue. 

 

Drink Bottle Materials:

  • There are 2 tiny rings of food grade silicon inside the lid to keep it waterproof and functional
  • 304 food grade stainlesss steel

  • no lead is present on the surface of the drink bottle that comes into contact with the consumer nor the contents of the product.

More info: 

This drink bottles incredible thermal performance and durability utilizes vacuum insulation in its double-wall stainless steel vessel. To achieve this standard, a small sealing bead (pellet), or solder, is used. The sealing bead contains lead in its composition, but it is fully encapsulated and inaccessible. The use of lead in the composition of a sealing bead to achieve vacuum insulation in double-wall stainless steel drinkware is common practice in the industry, being done by brands like Yeti and Stanley cups for years. Salty Aura takes product safety very seriously, especially as related to possible exposure to lead. For this reason, Salty Auras Drinkware is robustly designed to fully encapsulate the sealing bead to prevent any direct lead exposure. These have undergone lead testing coming back with zero lead detected on the inside and outside of these powder coated bottles every time.

description.plain:
A 25 oz water bottle holds 750 ml, more than a 16.9 oz disposable bottle, in a body slim enough for a cup holder. The Elemental Classic 25oz Water Bottle is a double-wall vacuum insulated stainless steel water bottle with a natural bamboo lid. It keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours or hot for up to 12 hours.

Unlike a single-use plastic bottle, the Classic is reusable drinkware built for years of everyday hydration, and it doesn't sweat or hold onto old flavors.

25 oz Water Bottle Design, Materials, and Everyday Functionality

The Classic is built from durable, food-safe materials:

  • 18/8 stainless steel: Food-grade stainless steel with an odor-free interior and BPA-free materials.
  • Natural bamboo lid: A stainless steel screw-on cap topped with bamboo for a warm, natural look.
  • Metal ring handle: Hook it on a finger or clip it to a backpack.
  • Powder-coated finish: A durable powder-coated surface that adds grip and resists everyday wear.
  • Leak-proof lid: The screw-on cap seals tight for bags and car rides.

At about 10 inches tall with the cap, 3 inches across and 13.5 oz empty, it's an easy-to-carry water bottle for work, the gym and weekend trips.

How Vacuum Insulation Keeps Your Drinks Hot or Cold for Longer

Vacuum insulation keeps drinks hot or cold by removing the air between two stainless steel walls. With no air in the gap, very little heat can move in or out.

That double-wall insulation gives the Classic 24-hour cold retention and 12-hour heat retention, so it works for hot and cold beverage storage: iced water on a summer hike, or hot tea on a winter commute. The outer wall stays at room temperature, which means a condensation-free exterior with no wet rings on desks or damp bags.

Slim Water Bottle Design with a Wide Mouth for Easy Filling and Cleaning

The Classic's slim bottle design is 3 inches across, so it fits most car cup holders and backpack side pockets. That makes it a practical travel water bottle and portable hydration solution for commutes, flights and road trips.

The opening is wide enough to add ice, refill quickly at a water fountain and reach inside with a bottle brush. A leak-resistant screw cap keeps everything sealed between refills.

How to Clean and Care for Your Double-Wall Insulated Water Bottle

  • Wash the bottle by hand with warm, soapy water and a bottle brush before first use and after each day.
  • Wipe the bamboo lid with a damp cloth and don't soak it.
  • Don't microwave or freeze the bottle, and keep hot drinks below 140°F (60°C).
  • Open the cap slowly if the bottle holds a carbonated drink.
  • Air dry with the cap off to keep the interior odor-free.

Why Choose the Elemental Classic 25oz Water Bottle?

The Elemental Classic is a simple, durable 25 oz stainless steel water bottle with a natural bamboo lid. It holds 750 ml, keeps drinks cold for a full day, fits your cup holder and comes in a wide range of colors. Prefer straws? Swap in the Elemental Classic Sport Cap. And 3% of Elemental's profits go to clean water projects.

FAQs

How much water does a 25 oz water bottle hold?

A 25 oz water bottle holds about 750 ml, roughly three cups of water. That's about 50% more than a standard 16.9 oz disposable water bottle.

Does the Classic 25oz Water Bottle keep drinks hot and cold?

Yes. Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and hot for up to 12 hours. For hot drinks, fill below 140°F (60°C).

Is the 25 oz stainless steel water bottle leak proof?

Yes. The stainless steel screw-on cap seals tight, so the bottle is leak-proof in a bag when the cap is fully tightened. Open it slowly with carbonated drinks.

Does this slim water bottle fit in standard car cup holders?

Yes. At 3 inches across, the Classic 25 oz fits most standard car cup holders and backpack side pockets.

What is the difference between a vacuum insulated and a double-wall water bottle?

A double-wall bottle has two stainless steel walls. A vacuum insulated bottle also removes the air between them, which blocks heat far better. The Classic is both.

Can I put ice cubes inside the wide mouth water bottle?

Yes. Standard ice cubes fit through the opening, and the vacuum insulation keeps them frozen for hours.

Is the 25 oz insulated water bottle suitable for hiking and traveling?

Yes. It weighs about 13.5 oz empty, seals with a leak-proof cap and has a metal ring handle you can clip to a pack. It keeps water cold all day on the trail.

description.plain:
Fill a large room with the Maple Butter 3-Wick Candle from Goose Creek, a highly scented candle poured from our proprietary soy wax blend. Each 14.5 oz jar burns up to 45 hours across three 100% lead-free wicks.

Product details

  • Proprietary soy wax blend
  • Net weight 14.5 oz (411 g)
  • Up to 45 hours of burn time
  • 3 wicks, 100% lead-free
  • Scent family: Bakery
  • Highly scented with premium fragrance oils and essential oils

How to use

Light all three wicks every time you burn the candle. On the first burn, let it run 2 to 3 hours so the wax melts all the way to the edge of the jar. That full melt pool is what prevents tunneling later. Trim the wicks to 1/4 inch before each burn, and keep sessions to 3 hours or less.

Why three wicks

Three wicks melt wax across the full width of the jar instead of a narrow channel down the center. That wider melt pool releases more fragrance at once, so a 3-wick candle scents a large, open room faster than a single-wick candle of the same size. Burning only one or two wicks shrinks the melt pool and cuts the scent throw the candle was built to deliver.

Burn safely: place the candle on a heat-resistant, sturdy surface away from drafts, windows, and air vents. Keep candles out of reach of children and pets, and never leave a burning candle unattended.

Making a cup of Coffee is my favorite morning ritual. I jump out of bed at sunrise, when the house is dark and quiet, and I head to the kitchen. All I can hear is the roosters down at the orchard, and I have a moment with myself as the rich aroma floats all the way through the house.

I’m obsessed with Coffee. And it took us years to get it right. Our Medium Roast is a rich dance of flavors: toasted Cacao, Toffee, Ripe Cherry, and poised acidity. Our beans are sustainably grown in lush soil by Coffee farmers in Guatemala and Colombia, who are paid a verified living wage and provided with stable, long-term demand to support their livelihood and communities.

Roasted to preserve freshness, this Coffee is crafted to be used within three weeks. The result is an exceptionally nuanced smell and taste, and a Coffee that I've always dreamed of making. Standing for something strong, from farmers we know and love.

x Richard

description.plain:
Making a cup of Coffee is my favorite morning ritual. I jump out of bed at sunrise, when the house is dark and quiet, and I head to the kitchen. All I can hear is the roosters down at the orchard, and I have a moment with myself as the rich aroma floats all the way through the house.

I’m obsessed with Coffee. And it took us years to get it right. Our Medium Roast is a rich dance of flavors: toasted Cacao, Toffee, Ripe Cherry, and poised acidity. Our beans are sustainably grown in lush soil by Coffee farmers in Guatemala and Colombia, who are paid a verified living wage and provided with stable, long-term demand to support their livelihood and communities.

Roasted to preserve freshness, this Coffee is crafted to be used within three weeks. The result is an exceptionally nuanced smell and taste, and a Coffee that I've always dreamed of making. Standing for something strong, from farmers we know and love.

x Richard

Packaged in a paper pouch*

Every piece is individually cut by hand, so you'll notice natural variations in shape, thickness, size and colour. That's exactly how we like it — real meat prepared by hand rather than processed into perfectly uniform pieces.

🥩 Why We Use Beef Silverside

Not all beef jerky is made from the same cut.

At Natura Paws, we use Australian beef silverside because it provides a great combination of lean meat, rich beef flavour and natural chewiness when dehydrated.

The meat is prepared and sliced by hand, then carefully dehydrated to remove moisture and concentrate its naturally rich beef flavour.

There's no need for marinades, flavour enhancers, added salt or artificial preservatives.

The ingredient is the flavour — real Australian beef.

✋ Hand-Cut Means Every Piece is Unique

Our beef jerky isn't stamped out by a machine.

Because each batch is hand-cut from real silverside, individual pieces naturally vary in size, thickness, shape and texture.

Some pieces may be larger and chewier, while thinner pieces can have a firmer crunch. This natural variation is part of what makes our jerky genuinely handmade.

From slicing the fresh silverside through to dehydrating and packing the finished jerky, our process remains deliberately simple and hands-on.

Real Meat. Nothing Unnecessary. Natura Paws.

And it means our entire team of passionate pet people are valued and cared for as part of the West Paw family—from our American production teams, to our select domestic and international partners who deliver exceptional quality with ethical practices.

Even though these organ meats are some of the most nutritious offerings from the highest-quality livestock, they tend to just get discarded. So West Paw's air-dried dog treats make the most of a nutrition powerhouse that would otherwise go to waste. Less waste, more taste—it’s a good time to be a dog.

West Paw's freeze dried beef treats are made with American Grassfed® beef.  AGA standards guarantee 100% grass-fed diets (no grain finishing), free-range grazing on pastures (not feedlots), no antibiotics or growth hormones, and all animals born & humanely raised on American family farms.

More about West Paw:
West Paw is proud to be family owned and operated since 1996. Since the very beginning, we've incorporated thoughtful design into our eco-friendly, easy-clean toys, beds, leashes, and collars. We care about every step in the process—every hand and paw that goes into product design, testing, manufacturing and enjoyment.

So how do we define "responsibly made?" It means we manufacture everything with care using safe, sustainable materials that are better for the earth, for our workers, and for our pets. And it means our entire team of passionate pet people are valued and cared for as part of the West Paw family—from our American production teams, to our select domestic and international partners who deliver exceptional quality with ethical practices.

For you, it means you can trust that you're purchasing high-quality pet products made with passion and integrity. Everything we make is long-lasting, lovingly handcrafted—and always safe for pets, people, and the planet.

🧴 Paw Naturel Sugar Candy Dog Shampoo – Natural Dog Shampoo 200ml

A gentle, effective dog shampoo designed to cleanse, condition and leave the coat fresh, soft and easy to manage.

The Paw Naturel Sugar Candy Shampoo is one of our most popular fragrances, loved for its sweet, clean scent and trusted for its consistent grooming results.

Formulated using carefully selected, skin-conscious ingredients, it helps maintain coat condition while delivering an effective cleanse without harsh detergents, making it suitable for regular use, including on puppies.

🍭 Scent Profile

A light, sweet candy-inspired fragrance with a clean, fresh finish.

Designed to sit lightly on the coat without overwhelming sensitive noses, leaving dogs smelling fresh and well-groomed rather than heavily perfumed.

💎 Key Benefits

  • Hypoallergenic formula with carefully selected, skin-conscious ingredients
  • Packed with vitamins B, C and E to support skin and coat health
  • Naturally brightens, helping lift stains and enhance coat colour
  • Cleanses and conditions in one step
  • Rinses off quickly, helping reduce water usage
  • Helps cut drying time
  • Naturally deodorising for a clean, fresh finish
  • Puppy-friendly and gentle enough for frequent use
  • Tear-free formula for a more comfortable wash
  • Gentle on both the coat and the hands that apply it

🐾 Ideal for:

  • Regular washing and maintenance
  • Dogs of all breeds and coat types
  • Everyday home grooming
  • Maintaining a fresh, clean coat between grooms
  • Puppies and sensitive skin

Developed from real grooming experience, this shampoo is designed to deliver effective cleaning while supporting coat and skin health.

  • Free from SLS / SLES / ALS, alcohol and parabens
  • Helps maintain a soft, manageable coat
  • Supports shine and overall coat condition
  • Suitable for frequent use
  • Light, long-lasting fragrance
  • Made using carefully selected ingredients
  • Vegan and vegetarian friendly
  • Cruelty free – tested on humans
  • Made in the UK

🚫 Free from:

  • SLS / SLES / ALS
  • Alcohol
  • Parabens
  • Harsh detergents

🧴 How to use

Can be applied neat or diluted up to 32:1 using a mixing bottle.

Apply to wet coat, massage gently through, then rinse thoroughly.

Suitable for use in hydrobaths.

👉 For best results, use with the Paw Naturel Mixing Bottle to ensure correct dilution and even distribution.

📦 Product Details

Product type: Dog shampoo
Size: 200ml
Fragrance: Sugar Candy
Suitable for regular use

For easier use and more accurate application, pair your shampoo with:

  • 30ml Pump Dispenser – designed to fit our 2 litre and 5 litre bottles, allowing for quick, consistent and mess-free dispensing

👉 These additions help reduce product waste, improve ease of use and create a more efficient grooming routine, whether at home or in a professional environment.

🔄 Size Options

Also available in:

30ml – ideal for trial or travel
2 litre – regular use and multi-dog households
5 litre – professional use and best value

👉 Choose the size that suits your routine.

🧠 Why Dilution Matters

Diluting shampoo correctly helps improve performance while protecting the coat.

Pre-mixing allows for:

Better distribution through the coat
More effective cleansing
Easier rinsing
Less product waste

🧪 Ingredients

Aqua, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Glycerin, Saccharomyces Ferment Filtrate, Sodium Chloride, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Parfum, PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Panthenol (Vitamin B5), Niacinamide (Vitamin B3), Sodium Starch Octenylsuccinate, Calcium Pantothenate, Maltodextrin, Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate (Vitamin C), Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E), Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Silica.

💬 From the Grooming Table

As a professional dog groomer, consistency is everything.

A shampoo needs to clean effectively, rinse easily and leave the coat in a workable, healthy condition without causing irritation or build-up, saving time and water.

This formula has been developed to deliver reliable results every time, whether used at home or in a busy grooming environment.

Carefully prepared in small batches on Sydney’s Northern Beaches, our extra lean beef mince is gently freeze-dried to remove moisture while helping preserve its natural flavour, aroma and nutritional qualities.

With no artificial colours, flavours, preservatives, grains or fillers, it's simply real Australian beef transformed into a lightweight, crunchy treat dogs and cats love.

One ingredient. 100% Australian Extra Lean Beef Mince. Nothing else.

🥩 Why You'll Love It

  • 100% Australian Extra Lean Beef Mince – real beef with nothing unnecessary added
  • Extra Lean – made specifically using extra lean beef mince
  • Single Ingredient – simple and easy to understand
  • Naturally High in Protein – provides essential amino acids needed for healthy muscles and normal body function
  • Rich in Vitamin B12 – important for normal energy metabolism and red blood cell formation
  • Natural Source of Iron – contributes to normal oxygen transport and red blood cell production
  • Naturally Rich in Zinc – an essential mineral involved in normal immune function, skin health and metabolism
  • Contains Selenium – an important trace mineral involved in normal antioxidant and immune functions
  • Naturally Occurring B Vitamins – including niacin (B3) and Vitamin B6
  • Light & Crunchy – perfect for treating, training or crumbling over meals
  • Suitable for Dogs & Cats
  • No Artificial Preservatives, Colours or Flavours

🌿 Naturally Occurring Nutrients

Extra lean Australian beef naturally provides:

High-Quality Protein • Essential Amino Acids • Vitamin B12 • Vitamin B6 • Niacin (B3) • Iron • Zinc • Selenium • Phosphorus

Together, these nutrients contribute to normal muscle maintenance, energy metabolism, red blood cell formation, immune function and overall wellbeing.

As a natural whole-food product, exact nutrient levels can vary between batches.

🥩 Why Extra Lean Beef Mince?

We specifically use extra lean beef mince to create a protein-rich treat with less fat than regular beef mince.

The minced texture also allows us to create convenient pieces that are easy to feed, break apart for training or crumble over your pet's regular meals.

It's a simple way to add the naturally rich flavour of Australian beef without unnecessary ingredients.

🐶🐱 Perfect for Treating, Training & Topping

Feed straight from the pouch as a crunchy reward, break into smaller portions for training, or crumble over your pet's regular food as a high-protein meal topper.

The lightweight freeze-dried texture makes it easy to portion while delivering the rich beef flavour dogs and cats love.

🐾 Feeding Guide

  • Cats & Small Dogs (up to 10kg): 3–5g daily
  • Medium Dogs (10–25kg): 5–10g daily
  • Large Dogs (25–40kg): 10–15g daily
  • Extra Large Dogs (40kg+): 15–20g daily

Adjust according to your pet's size, activity level and overall diet. Treats should generally make up no more than 10% of your pet's daily calorie intake.

Always supervise your pet while feeding and ensure fresh drinking water is available.

🇦🇺 Small-Batch Freeze-Dried on Sydney's Northern Beaches

Every pouch of Natura Paws Freeze-Dried Extra Lean Beef Mince is carefully prepared, freeze-dried and hand-packed in small batches on Sydney's Northern Beaches.

Our freeze-drying process removes moisture while helping preserve the natural taste and nutritional qualities of the fresh beef, creating a convenient, crunchy treat made from real Australian meat.

100% Australian Extra Lean Beef Mince. 100% Natural. One Ingredient.

Freeze-Dried Fresh by Natura Paws.

description.plain:
High-Value Dog Training Treats That Actually Work

Jack’s Premium Training Treats make training a flavorful, high-reward experience your dog won’t ignore.

These bite-sized dog training treats are crafted with real, high-quality beef and a carefully selected blend of natural ingredients to deliver a high-value reward that keeps your dog focused and motivated. Whether you're training a puppy or reinforcing good behavior in an adult dog, these treats are designed to get results.

Infused with nutrient-rich blackstrap molasses and a subtle smoky flavor, they’re irresistibly appealing—even for picky dogs.

Their small, durable design means they won’t crumble in your pocket or treat pouch, making them perfect for on-the-go training sessions, long walks, or obedience work.

Made in the USA and completely free from grains, preservatives, and artificial additives, these treats support your dog’s health while helping you train more effectively.

Why These Are the Best Dog Training Treats

  • Bite-sized for quick rewards during training
  • High-value flavor dogs love (great for stubborn or distracted dogs)
  • Durable and mess-free in your pocket or pouch
  • Grain-free and made with clean, natural ingredients
  • Ideal for puppies, adult dogs, and senior dogs

Is Blackstrap Molasses Good for Dogs?

Blackstrap molasses can be safe and even beneficial for dogs when used in small, controlled amounts—like in high-quality dog treats.

This nutrient-dense syrup is produced during the final stage of sugarcane processing and contains naturally occurring minerals such as iron, calcium, magnesium, and potassium, along with B vitamins. These nutrients can support red blood cell production, bone health, and overall energy levels.

For senior dogs, some owners report added benefits like improved vitality and mobility support.

In addition to its nutritional value, blackstrap molasses enhances the flavor of treats—making it an excellent choice for high-value dog training rewards.

description.plain:
High-Value Dog Training Treats That Actually Work

Jack’s Premium Training Treats make training a flavorful, high-reward experience your dog won’t ignore.

These bite-sized dog training treats are crafted with real, high-quality beef and a carefully selected blend of natural ingredients to deliver a high-value reward that keeps your dog focused and motivated. Whether you're training a puppy or reinforcing good behavior in an adult dog, these treats are designed to get results.

Infused with nutrient-rich blackstrap molasses and a subtle smoky flavor, they’re irresistibly appealing—even for picky dogs.

Their small, durable design means they won’t crumble in your pocket or treat pouch, making them perfect for on-the-go training sessions, long walks, or obedience work.

Made in the USA and completely free from grains, preservatives, and artificial additives, these treats support your dog’s health while helping you train more effectively.

Why These Are the Best Dog Training Treats

  • Bite-sized for quick rewards during training
  • High-value flavor dogs love (great for stubborn or distracted dogs)
  • Durable and mess-free in your pocket or pouch
  • Grain-free and made with clean, natural ingredients
  • Ideal for puppies, adult dogs, and senior dogs

Is Blackstrap Molasses Good for Dogs?

Blackstrap molasses can be safe and even beneficial for dogs when used in small, controlled amounts—like in high-quality dog treats.

This nutrient-dense syrup is produced during the final stage of sugarcane processing and contains naturally occurring minerals such as iron, calcium, magnesium, and potassium, along with B vitamins. These nutrients can support red blood cell production, bone health, and overall energy levels.

For senior dogs, some owners report added benefits like improved vitality and mobility support.

In addition to its nutritional value, blackstrap molasses enhances the flavor of treats—making it an excellent choice for high-value dog training rewards.

Why We Use Molasses in Our Dog Treats

We use blackstrap molasses as a natural alternative to artificial binders and preservatives.

It helps hold the treats together while maintaining a soft, durable texture that doesn’t fall apart during training. The natural sugars also help preserve freshness without relying on synthetic additives.

The result: a cleaner, more natural dog treat that performs better in real training situations.
